title: OpenBao HA/Raft
description: OpenBao HA/Raft. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. Native alert parity is not mapped. See the profile validation record for tested environments.

options.query:
| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_core_active")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster instance scrape_profile
| stats sum(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_raft_replication_appendEntries_logs")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_raft_replication_appendEntries_logs"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_raft_replication_appendEntries_logs","raft_replication_appendEntries_logs") ." | ".coalesce(peer_id,"(missing)") ." | ".instance ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| stats max(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_autopilot_healthy")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster instance scrape_profile
| stats max(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_autopilot_node_healthy")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| eval series=cluster." / ".scrape_profile." / ".node_id
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=0 useother=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_raft_state_candidate")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_raft_state_candidate"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_raft_state_candidate","raft_state_candidate") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate30m`
| eval value=value*1800
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster instance scrape_profile seal_state_source
| eventstats max(eval(if(seal_state_source="cluster",1,0))) AS has_cluster BY cluster instance scrape_profile
| where seal_state_source="cluster" OR has_cluster=0
| stats max(value) AS value BY cluster instance scrape_profile
| stats sum(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile

viz_active_nodes.title: Active nodes
viz_active_nodes.description: Sum of fresh active flags across targets.

viz_append_entries_logs.title: Append entries logs
viz_append_entries_logs.description: Fresh source gauge; duplicate node observations are combined before totals. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_candidate_transitions.title: Candidate transitions
viz_candidate_transitions.description: Rolling 30m calculation from upstream counters; resets are corrected per complete source series before aggregation. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_leader_last_contact.title: Leader last contact p99
viz_leader_last_contact.description: Per-target source p99 last-contact duration in milliseconds. Quantiles are not averaged across targets.

viz_leader_transitions.title: Leader transitions
viz_leader_transitions.description: Rolling 30m calculation from upstream counters; resets are corrected per complete source series before aggregation. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_raft_fsm_pending.title: FSM pending
viz_raft_fsm_pending.description: Raft FSM pending operations by target.

viz_raft_storage_logs.title: Raft and storage logs
viz_raft_storage_logs.description: OpenBao JSON operational logs. Only timestamp, host, severity, module, and message are exposed. Error text can contain sensitive information. Charts use disjoint five-minute buckets; this is not a client-latency measurement.

viz_replication_heartbeat.title: Replication heartbeat p99
viz_replication_heartbeat.description: Source p99 replication heartbeat duration by peer_id, in milliseconds.

viz_unhealthy_raft_nodes.title: Unhealthy Raft nodes
viz_unhealthy_raft_nodes.description: Autopilot node-health flags deduplicated by node_id using the minimum across reporters, then counted. This measures peer health, not voter count or quorum margin.

viz_unsealed_nodes.title: Unsealed nodes
viz_unsealed_nodes.description: Sum of fresh unsealed states, with duplicate-source preference and missing-state preservation.
